title: rorca-integrations
_notes: PRIORITY: GitHub integration is the ONLY launch blocker. INT-001 through INT-015 cover GitHub. Linear (INT-016–027), Vercel (INT-028–039), Slack (INT-040–051) are post-launch. Run GitHub stories first — stop after INT-015 for launch if needed.

userStories.title: Integration Settings Hub Page
userStories.description: A unified integrations page within Settings showing all provider connection statuses and management controls. GitHub is the primary integration for launch; Linear, Vercel, Slack are post-launch.
acceptanceCriteria: New 'Integrations' tab in Settings (alongside Direction Stack, Model, Account)
Each integration card: provider logo, name, status badge (Connected/Disconnected/Error), Connect/Disconnect button
Cards: Linear, GitHub (deeper), Vercel, Slack
Error state shows last error message with retry option
'Test connection' button per integration sends ping and shows latency
Integration cards sorted: connected first, then disconnected

userStories.title: Credentials Vault with AES-256-GCM Encryption
userStories.description: All integration API tokens and secrets are stored encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM.
acceptanceCriteria: New DB table integration_credentials (id, workspace_id, provider, ciphertext, iv, tag, created_at, updated_at)
AES-256-GCM encryption using Node crypto module
Encryption key derived from CREDENTIALS_SECRET env var (required on startup)
Decryption only in-memory, never logged or exposed in API responses
API never returns raw tokens — only masked last 4 chars
Credentials rotate: new encrypt+store replaces old without downtime
Migration 037_integration_credentials.sql created (existing migrations go 001–036; next available is 037)

userStories.title: Webhook Infrastructure — Receiver and Signature Router
userStories.description: A shared webhook endpoint routes incoming webhooks to the correct integration handler with signature verification.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/webhooks/:provider receives all inbound webhooks
Provider-specific signature verification before processing (fail fast on bad sig)
Async processing: webhook accepted (200) immediately, processed in background
Dead letter queue: failed webhook payloads stored in webhook_failures table for retry
Retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m)
Webhook delivery log stored in integration_audit_log table
Migration 038_webhook_infrastructure.sql created (037 is taken by integration_credentials — use 038)

userStories.title: Integration Health Dashboard
userStories.description: A real-time dashboard showing the health of all connected integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Health panel in Integration Settings: last sync time, error count (24h), status indicator
Status: Healthy (green), Degraded (amber, >1 error in 24h), Down (red, last sync >1h ago)
'Refresh' button triggers live health check for all integrations
Error log expandable: last 10 errors with timestamp and message
Auto-refresh every 60 seconds
Health data stored in integration_health table with TTL cleanup

userStories.title: Integration Audit Log

acceptanceCriteria: integration_audit_log table: id, provider, action, workspace_id, payload_summary, status, created_at
Actions logged: token_stored, token_rotated, webhook_received, sync_triggered, sync_completed, sync_failed
API endpoint GET /api/integrations/audit-log with pagination
Audit log viewable in Settings > Integrations > Audit Log tab
Log entries never deleted (append-only), retained 90 days
Sensitive data redacted from payload_summary (tokens replaced with [REDACTED])

userStories.title: Integration Enable/Disable Toggle Per Workspace

userStories.title: Rate Limit Handler with Exponential Backoff
userStories.description: All outbound integration API calls respect provider rate limits with automatic backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP 429 responses trigger retry with Retry-After header respected
If no Retry-After: exponential backoff 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s (max 4 retries)

Per-provider rate limit config: Linear (400 req/min), GitHub (5000 req/hr), Vercel (200 req/min), Slack (1 req/sec per method)
In-memory rate limit counter per provider per workspace
Circuit breaker: disable provider after 10 consecutive failures, auto-retry after 5 minutes
